The '''Serenno theater''' was one of the six theaters of operations of the [[Outer Rim Sieges/Legends|Outer Rim Sieges]], which took place during the final stages of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Astrography==
The Serenno theater was located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], along the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]].<ref name="TEA" /> This field of operations was named after the key [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Serenno/Legends|Serenno]].<ref name="TEGtW" />

==History==
In the Serenno theater, [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]-led [[Fleet/Legends|fleets]] from the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] assaulted [[New Bornalex/Legends|New Bornalex]] and [[Ord Radama/Legends|Ord Radama]] in an attempt to reach the key world of [[Celanon/Legends|Celanon]] and [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku's]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of Serenno.<ref name="TEGtW" />
